title: OpenAI's Big Week In Tech

slides.headline: OpenAI's Big Week In Tech
slides.subtitle: From unlimited chats to a new smart speaker, here is what you need to know today.

slides.headline: OpenAI's smart speaker plans
slides.explanation: Reports suggest OpenAI is working on an AI-powered smart speaker priced between $300 and $400. This marks a potential move from the company into the physical home hardware market.

slides.headline: ChatGPT lifts chat limits
slides.explanation: Starting next week, free users will get unlimited text chats with ChatGPT. This removes the previous rate limits that often cut off conversations for casual users.

slides.headline: Google Wallet for kids
slides.explanation: Google is introducing a feature that lets parents set up secure spending balances for their children. It is designed to help kids learn financial habits while parents keep oversight.

slides.headline: OpenAI hits back at Apple
slides.explanation: OpenAI is arguing that Apple's own loose security practices undermine its trade secrets lawsuit. They point to instances where Apple allowed managers to access former employees' accounts.

slides.headline: Trevor Noah to host Google event
slides.explanation: Google has tapped comedian Trevor Noah to host its upcoming Made by Google launch event on August 12th. The show will also feature other celebrities like Alex Cooper.

caption:
It has been a busy few days for OpenAI and Google. From new hardware rumors to big changes for free AI users, we are breaking down the tech news that actually matters. Which of these updates are you most interested in?

title: Meta's $567M fine and top news today

slides.headline: Meta's $567M fine and top news today
slides.subtitle: Get the facts on the 5 stories you need to know right now.

slides.headline: Meta ordered to pay $567 million
slides.explanation: A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $567 million into a fund to help kids affected by social media. This ruling is a major step in holding tech companies accountable for their impact on mental health.

slides.headline: AI startup hit by hacker
slides.explanation: A rogue agent recently hacked into the AI startup Hugging Face. This incident highlights the growing security concerns surrounding the rapid development of artificial intelligence.

slides.headline: Trump plans overhaul of Head Start
slides.explanation: The Trump administration is planning to change regulations for the Head Start program for children. While officials say this will boost enrollment, critics worry it will undermine the quality of the program.

slides.headline: Humanitarian emergency in Ceuta
slides.explanation: Around 5,000 migrants remain in Ceuta as local officials warn of a humanitarian crisis. The situation has prompted urgent talks among EU lawmakers about border security and safety.

slides.headline: Nintendo profits jump after tariff refund
slides.explanation: Nintendo saw a 53% spike in profits largely due to a refund on Donald Trump's tariffs. It shows how changes in international trade policy can have a big impact on global companies.
